--CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0092_GET_RTF_ARCHEIVEMENT_RATE_SUMMARY]
 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0092_GET_RTF_ARCHEIVEMENT_RATE_SUMMARY]

    , @p_category_code            NVARCHAR(MAX)
    , @p_year                     NVARCHAR(4)
	, @p_dept_id                  NVARCHAR(4000)
    , @p_end_cu

_YYYYMMDD            NVARCHAR(8)

        , PRE_FROM_YYYYMMDD             NVARCHAR(8)
        , PRE_TO_YYYYMMDD               NVARCHAR(8)
        , DM_RTF_YN                     NVARCHAR(1)
        , FG_SEQ_P                      BIGINT  --FG
        , FG_SEQ_R                      BIGINT  --FG
    )

    DECLARE @V_CURR_ISO_YYYYWW          NVARCHAR(6) = N''
    DECLARE @V_CURR_THIS_ISO_YYYYWW     NVARCHAR(6) = N''
    DECLARE @V_CURR_THIS_FROM_YYYYMMDD  NVARCHAR(8) = N''
    DECLARE @V_CURR_THIS_TO_YYYYMMDD    NVARCHAR(8) = N''
    DECLARE @V_CURR_PRE_ISO_YYYYWW      NVARCHAR(6) = N''
    DECLARE @V_CURR_PRE_FROM_YYYYMMDD   NVARCHAR(8) = N''
    DECLARE @V_CURR_PRE_TO_YYYYMMDD     NVARCHAR(8) = N''
    DECLARE @V_CURR_DM_RTF_YN           NVARCHAR(1) = N''
    DECLARE @V_CURR_FG_SEQ_P            BIGINT
    DECLARE @V_CURR_FG_SEQ_R            BIGINT


    INSERT INTO #T_WEEKS_ALL
--    SELECT    C.ISO_YYYYWW
--            , ''
--            , ''
--            , ''
--            , ''
--            , ''
--            , ''
--            , A.DM_RTF_YN
--    FROM	[dbo].[SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN] A WITH(NOLOCK)
--            JOIN
--                (
--                    SELECT    ISO_YYYYWW
--                            , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
--                    FROM    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
--                    WHERE   DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
--                ) C ON
--                    A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
--    WHERE	1=1
--	    AND DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id
--	    --AND DM_RTF_YN = 'Y'
----시작일자 제한이 없어야 전주에 데이터가 없어도 이전까지 거슬러 찾음                    AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD >= @V_PRE_FROM_YYYYMMDD
--	    AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD <= @p_to_yyyymmdd
--    ORDER BY PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC
    SELECT    C.ISO_YYYYWW
            , ''
            , ''
            , ''
            , ''
            , ''
            , ''
            , ISNULL(A.DM_RTF_YN, 'Y') AS DM_RTF_YN
            , 1
            , 1
    FROM	(
                SELECT    ISO_YYYYWW

                    SELECT    DIVISION_ID

                    FROM    [dbo].[SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN] A WITH(NOLOCK)

	                    AND A.DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id
                ) A ON
                    C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD

    ORDER BY A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC

    GROUP BY PLAN_SEQ, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD

    SELECT    *
    FROM    #T_WEEKS_ALL
    ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW DESC;

        , @V_CURR_THIS_TO_YYYYMMDD

        , @V_CURR_PRE_FROM_YYYYMMDD

, @V_CURR_DM_RTF_YN
        , @V_CURR_FG_SEQ_P

    BEGIN

        FROM    #T_WEEKS_Y
        WHERE   ISO_YYYYWW <= @V_CURR_ISO_YYYYWW

        FROM    #TEMP_SEQ
        WHERE   1=1

            PRE_TO_YYYYMMDD     = ISNULL(@V_CURR_PRE_TO_YYYYMMDD, ''),

        , @V_CURR_THIS_TO_YYYYMMDD

            , THIS_TO_YYYYMMDD

            , PRE_FROM_YYYYMMDD
            , PRE_TO_YYYYMMDD
            , DM_RTF_YN
            , FG_SEQ_P
            , FG_SEQ_R
    FROM	#T_WEEKS_ALL
    ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW DESC

		                , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
		                , A.ITEM_ID
		                , A.INCOTERMS

		                , A.MEASURE
		                , A.YYYYMMDD
		                , A.QT

Y AS QTY
		                , A.QTY AS CELL_QTY
		                ,'P' AS PLAN_RESULT
                        , 3 AS GUBUN
                FROM
                        (
                            SELECT  F.*
                            FROM    DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_C F
						    WHERE   ((@p_division_id IS NULL OR @p_division_id = '') OR F.DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id)
	                                AND F.MEASURE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM #WHERE_MEASURE)
	                                AND F.QTY <> 0
                        ) A
                        JOIN
                            (
                                SELECT    V.DIVISION_ID --RTF 는 Result 와 달리 버전과 물리므로 DIVISION_ID + VERSION_NO 로 연결
                                        , C.ISO_YYYYWW
                                        , MAX(V.VERSION_NO) AS VERSION_NO
                                FROM    DM_MST_VERSION V
                                    JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C ON
                                            V.YYYYMMDD = C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                WHERE   VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
                                    AND ((@p_division_id IS NULL OR @p_division_id = '') OR DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id)
                                    AND VERSION_DESCRIPTION   = 'MKT FCST Weekly Cutoff'  -- 정기 CUTOFF 만 해당
                                GROUP BY V.DIVISION_ID, C.ISO_YYYYWW
                            ) V ON
							        A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID --RTF 는 Result 와 달리 버전과 물리므로 DIVISION_ID + VERSION_NO 로 연결

                                AND V.ISO_YYYYWW = IIF(@p_is_pre_week = 'T', @p_pre_iso_yyyyww, @p_this_iso_yyyyww)
                        JOIN #T_TERMS T ON

                        JOIN #T_TERMS T ON

--CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0092_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_MONTH_WEEK]
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0092_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_MONTH_WEEK]
  	  @p_year             NVARCHAR(4)
--DECLARE  	  @p_year             NVARCHAR(4) = '2022';
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE     @V_PRE_YYYYMM       NVARCHAR(6)         = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @p_year + '0101'), 112), 1, 6);
    DECLARE     @V_POST_YYYYMM      NVARCHAR(6)         = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH,  1, @p_year + '1201'), 112), 1, 6);
    
    DECLARE     @V_THIS_MONDAY      NVARCHAR(8)         = CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY( GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112);

    DECLARE     @V_THIS_YYYYMM      NVARCHAR(6)         = SUBSTRING(@V_THIS_MONDAY, 1, 6)

    --IF @V_POST_YYYYMM > @V_THIS_YYYYMM
    --BEGIN
    --    SET @V_POST_YYYYMM = @V_THIS_YYYYMM
    --END

    
    --PRINT @V_PRE_YYYYMM;
    --PRINT @V_POST_YYYYMM;
    --RETURN;

    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TBL_SCP0092_WEEK_MONTH_INFO') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #TBL_SCP0092_WEEK_MONTH_INFO;

    SELECT    X.*
            , @p_year + '-' + X.MM AS MONTH_NAME
    INTO    #TBL_SCP0092_WEEK_MONTH_INFO
    FROM
            (
                SELECT    SUBSTRING(A.ISO_YYYYMM, 1, 4)  AS YYYY
                        , SUBSTRING(A.ISO_YYYYMM, 5, 2)  AS MM
                        , WEEK_NAME
                        , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) AS BASIS_START_DATE
                        , MAX(A.BASIS_END_DATE) AS BASIS_END_DATE
	            FROM    [dbo].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)
	            WHERE       A.ISO_YYYYMM >= @V_PRE_YYYYMM
                        AND A.ISO_YYYYMM <= @V_POST_YYYYMM
                GROUP BY  SUBSTRING(A.ISO_YYYYMM, 1, 4)
                        , SUBSTRING(A.ISO_YYYYMM, 5, 2)
                        , WEEK_NAME
            ) X
    WHERE   X.YYYY = @p_year -- 전년도에 걸쳐있으면 전년도에 합산되므로 제외
    ORDER BY X.MM, X.WEEK_NAME;

    --SELECT *FROM #TBL_SCP0092_WEEK_MONTH_INFO; RETURN;

	SELECT	  'W_' + @p_year + A.MM + RIGHT(WEEK_NAME, 2)       AS COLUMN_NAME
			, A.WEEK_NAME									    AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
			, A.WEEK_NAME									    AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
			, A.MONTH_NAME						                AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
			, 'W'											    AS DAY_CODE
			, MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) + CONVERT(CHAR(2), 21)    AS SORT_ORDER_NO
	FROM    #TBL_SCP0092_WEEK_MONTH_INFO A WITH(NOLOCK)
    GROUP BY A.MM, A.MONTH_NAME, A.WEEK_NAME
	UNION ALL
	SELECT    'M_' + @p_year + A.MM   							AS COLUMN_NAME
			, A.MONTH_NAME									    AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
			, A.MONTH_NAME									    AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
			, A.MONTH_NAME									    AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
			, 'M'												AS DAY_CODE
			--, MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) + CONVERT(CHAR(2), '01')  AS SORT_ORDER_NO
			, MAX(A.BASIS_END_DATE) + CONVERT(CHAR(2), '01')  AS SORT_ORDER_NO --월컬럼을 주마지막 다음으로 이동
	FROM	#TBL_SCP0092_WEEK_MONTH_INFO A WITH(NOLOCK)
    GROUP BY A.MM, A.MONTH_NAME
	ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0092_GET_WEEK_TERM]
--ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0092_GET_WEEK_TERM]
	@p_week_name                NVARCHAR(50)
AS  
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_NULLS ON
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON; 

    DECLARE @V_NOW_YYYYMMDD	NCHAR(8);

    SET @V_NOW_YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112);


    --파라미터가 널이면 오늘 기준 최근 날짜로 검색
    IF (@p_week_name IS NULL OR @p_week_name ='')
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP(1)
                  C.BASIS_START_DATE
                , C.BASIS_END_DATE
        FROM    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
                INNER JOIN 
                    (
                        SELECT  MAX(ISO_YYYYWW) ISO_YYYYWW
                        FROM    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                        WHERE   1=1
                                AND BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= @V_NOW_YYYYMMDD
                    ) X ON C.ISO_YYYYWW = X.ISO_YYYYWW
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT    C.BASIS_START_DATE
                , C.BASIS_END_DATE
        FROM    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
        WHERE   1=1
                AND C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD + '-' + C.WEEK_NAME = @p_week_name;
    END
END

				 , C.VALID_YN

			FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS] C WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE  1 = 1    
			AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = @p_program_id
			AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = @p_sheet_name
			AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
			AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
			AND	 @p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(C.DIVISION_ID ,',') )
			UNION ALL
			SELECT * FROM (
				SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
					 , C.SHEET_NAME
					 , C.COLUMN_NAME
					 , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
					 , C.SORT_ORDER_NO        --CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
					 , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
					 , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
					 , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
					 , '' AS DAY_CODE
					 , C.FIXED_FLAG
					 , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
					 , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
					 , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
					 , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
					 , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
					 , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
					 , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
					 , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
					 , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
					 , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
					 , C.VALID_YN
					 , C.DIVISION_ID
				FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS] C WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  1 = 1    
				AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = @p_program_id
				AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = @p_sheet_name
				AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
				AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = ''			
				AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
				AND	 @p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(C.DIVISION_ID ,',') )
				UNION ALL

				SELECT @p_program_id   AS PROGRAM_ID
					 , @p_sheet_name AS SHEET_NAME
					 , T.COLUMN_NAME
					 , T.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
					 , T.SORT_ORDER_NO
					 , ''         AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
					 , T.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
					 , T.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
					 , T.DAY_CODE
					 , ''         AS FIXED_FLAG
					 , 50         AS COLUMN_WIDTH
					 , 'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
					 , ''         AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
					 , ''         AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
					 , ''         AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
					 , 'R'        AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
					 , 'Y'        AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
					 , 'Y'        AS VISIBLE_FLAG
					 , ''         AS DEFAULT_FLAG
					 , ''         AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
					 , ''         AS VALID_YN
					 --, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('81', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('82', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 THEN
						--	CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('40', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 THEN '40,81,82'
						--		 ELSE '81,82' END
					 --  ELSE 
						--	'40'
					 --  END AS DIVISION_ID
					 , @p_division_id		-- 20190201
				FROM  (
					   SELECT 'D_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD   AS COLUMN_NAME
							, A.CALENDAR_DAY            AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME   
							, A.WEEK_NAME               AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
							, A.MONTH_NAME              AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME 
							, A.DAYOFWEEK               AS DAY_CODE
							, A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD + CONVERT(CHAR(2), 31) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
					   FROM   [dbo].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)	
					   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_start_yyyymmdd --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
					   AND    A.basis_yyyymmdd <= @p_end_yyyymmdd --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
					   AND    1 = CASE WHEN @p_bucket = 'DAILY' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END
					   UNION ALL				   
					   SELECT 'W_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMM + A.ISO_WEEK   AS COLUMN_NAME
							, A.WEEK_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME   
							, A.WEEK_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
							, A.MONTH_NAME         AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME 
							, ''                   AS DAY_CODE
							, A.BASIS_START_DATE + CONVERT(CHAR(2), 21) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
					   FROM

[dbo].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)	
					   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_start_yyyymmdd --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
					   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= @p_end_yyyymmdd --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
					   GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
							  , A.ISO_WEEK 
							  , A.WEEK_NAME
							  , A.MONTH_NAME        
							  , A.BASIS_START_DATE
					   UNION ALL				  
					   SELECT 'M_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMM  AS COLUMN_NAME
							 , A.MONTH_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
							 , A.MONTH_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
							 , A.MONTH_NAME          AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
							 , ''                    AS DAY_CODE
							 , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) + CONVERT(CHAR(2), '01') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
					   FROM    [dbo].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)	
					   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_start_yyyymmdd --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
					   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= @p_end_yyyymmdd --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
					   GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
							  , A.MONTH_NAME	
					) T
				) A
				WHERE @p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(A.DIVISION_ID ,','))
			  ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO   ;
				  
        END;
END
